GATE REPAIR WAVE — Crew 1 FINAL REPORT

**COMMITS (flywheel):** `a768c73` — gate scripts: update verify-review-fixes.sh F1 + verify-0002.sh to post-se2.3 MailSurface architecture (2 files, +34/-8). Toron repo: NO commit (pin NOT bumped — blocker below).

**Per-gate diff summary:**
1. `verify-review-fixes.sh` F1 — include_body_md grep moved from `src/backend/mod.rs` (SearchFilter deleted by se2.3) to the live homes: `src/mail_shim.rs` (MailSearchFilter, line 191/202) AND `src/backend/wire.rs` (search_args, line 286). Both still assert the filter/wire carry include_body_md; main.rs body_md greps unchanged.
2. `verify-0002.sh` — two mail checks rewritten: (a) `trait MailBackend` grep → inverted honest check asserting the local trait stays DELETED (ADR-0007 MailSurface consume) + positive greps `pub use toron_core::mailbox::surface` (src/backend/mod.rs:56) and `toron_core::mailbox::Mailbox` (src/mail_shim.rs); (b) `-> Result<Box<dyn MailBackend>>` → `-> Result<Box<dyn MailSurface>>` (real symbol factory.rs:92).
3. `verify-0001.sh` HDR_PROTOCOL — **UNCHANGED, gate left red (blocker).**

**Gate outputs:**
- verify-review-fixes.sh: PASSED (16/16 OK; clippy 0 warnings)
- verify-0002.sh: PASSED (16/16 OK)
- verify-0001.sh: FAILED (1/5) — HDR_PROTOCOL only; register_agent/poll pair/bead-DAG/pane-identity all OK
- scripts/verify-clippy.sh: exit 0
- cargo test (2 runs): 329/330 passed, 3 ignored — see blockers

**BLOCKER 1 — HDR_PROTOCOL (pin NOT bumped, per instruction):** toron-core `crates/toron-core/src/backend/herdr.rs:29` pins 18; live herdr reports 19. Conformance audit of all 18 wire calls against `herdr api schema --json` (v19) + live socket probes: 17/18 conform. **`pane.wait_for_output` does NOT conform** — toron-core sends `{pane_id, mode, pattern, timeout_ms}`; v19 requires `{pane_id, source, match:{type,value}}`. Live probe: herdr rejects with `invalid_request: missing field 'source'`; v19-shape probe passes validation (pane_not_found = params OK). flywheel's own herdr_shim.rs:585-610 already sends the v19 shape. Fix is a 1-line params change toron-side (toron tracker has 0 open items — needs a toron bead, e.g. bd-8vg follow-up). HDR_PROTOCOL stays 18; verify-0001.sh stays red until the toron fix lands.

**BLOCKER 2 — cargo test 1 failure, NOT caused by my changes:** `durable::tests::spawn_prompts_carry_lease_renew_clause` fails because the working tree has UNCOMMITTED in-flight edits (another agent's lane — src/durable.rs prompt wording changed from "Renew your own agent-mail file reservations" to toron wording; test still asserts the old phrase). Tree was already dirty before my session (src/main.rs 136 lines, src/durable.rs, integrations/, AGENTS.md — none mine; I only touched the 2 gate scripts). `cron::tests::docker_upgrade_health_gate...` failed once under parallel load (sibling cargo run held the lock) but PASSES in isolation — flake, not regression. The owner of the src/durable.rs in-flight edit must update the test assertion in the same change.

**ADR note (flagged, NOT edited):** ADR-0002 body still describes the deleted `MailBackend` trait (lines 68, 76, 110, 268) — superseded by toron-side ADR-0007 (MailSurface consume, se2.3). Suggest an ADR-0002 amendment row documenting the supersession.

**Coordination:** switched to toron MCP per orchestrator instruction (reservations, announce, cargo slot, final report all on toron; earlier agent-mail MCP reservations released). Build slots disabled on agent-mail server; toron slot acquired + released. No .beads/ changes; nothing closed.
